svg.text: Fund Movement — Two Silent-Failure Bugs, One Dead Approval Path
InstantMudra Enterprises Admin Portal
⚠ CRITICAL — MoveToBankServiceImpl: AES branch never debits, always reports failure
sendPayoutRequest() — if ("AES".equalsIgnoreCase(credentials.getTokenType()))
AES branch (Admin Panel vendor)
1. generateTokenForAES()
2. restTemplate.exchange(...) — sends the payout
3. response received — never read or checked
✗ NO commonMethods.updateWallet() call anywhere
✗ NO return statement in this branch
→ falls through past the if/else entirely
else branch (RunPaisa / non-AES vendor) — for contrast
1. commonMethods.updateWallet(...) — debits FIRST
2. restTemplate.exchange(...) — sends the payout
3. checks payoutResponse.getStatus() == "ACCEPTED"
4. returns CommonResponse(200, ...) or (400, ...)
accordingly — correctly wired, real return either way
AES branch falls through to the method's final line:
return new CommonResponse<>(500, "Something went wrong", null);
Every AES-flow payout — successful or not — is reported as HTTP 500 to the caller, and the retailer's wallet is never debited either way.
⚠ CRITICAL — RazorpayPayoutServiceImpl.sendPayout() always returns null on success
try {
... create Razorpay contact + fund account if missing ...
PayoutResponseDto payoutResponse = createPayoutAPI(...); // computed, never used
} catch (Exception e) {
return PayoutResponseDto.builder().status("FAILED")...build(); // only path with a real return
} finally { commonFunctions.saveVendorLogs(...); }
return null; // ← unconditional, reached on every non-exception path
A genuinely successful payout takes the try block to completion normally — and still returns null.
Successful Razorpay payouts are indistinguishable from null/failure to every caller — money moves, the system reports it didn't.
FundRequestServiceImpl (dead approval path) vs. PrefundRequestServiceImpl (the live one)
FundRequestServiceImpl — approval is dead
✓ raiseFundRequest() — live, creates the request
✓ fetchAllRecords() — live, lists requests
✗ takeActionOnFundRequest() — entirely commented
out (43 lines). No approve/reject path exists
through this service at all — a request raised
here can never be actioned here.
PrefundRequestServiceImpl — the flow actually used
takeActionOnFundRequest() (~380 lines, live) resolves
product/subproduct/scheme, validates visibility, and
guards against double-processing:
if (status != PENDING) return 400 "already processed"
⚠ An earlier, ~40-line commented-out version of this
same method sits directly above the live one — the
"old version left as a comment" pattern from Module 2.
Minor: raiseFundRequest() — a third independent tree-walk, no cycle guard
while (true) { parentId = commonMethods.findParentHierarchy(currentId)... currentId = parentId; } climbs the parentAccount
chain looking for a WL/AD approver, with no depth limit or cycle check — vulnerable to an infinite loop if Module 2's parentAccount desync ever produces a cycle.
A third independent hierarchy-walking implementation, after Module 2's closure table and Module 8's DashboardServiceImpl.
Correctly implemented
Flagged risk / minor bug
Critical — confirmed financial-correctness bug
